correctness.rationale: A stable Lindblad resolvent is established by strict Hilbert–Schmidt dissipation. Direct integration of seven independent symmetry variables proves the exact formula. The positive definite Hessian and coercivity prove unique joint minimizers; derivative monotonicity and constrained two-scale asymptotics establish the sharp control laws. The full N^2-variable numerical cross-check passes 103 assertions, supplementary to the analytic proof.

originality.rationale: Four relevant full texts were inspected and statement-level comparisons rule out direct coverage by those objects: core-trapped extended star, fully connected Lindblad network, nonregular coherent transport, and general dark-state control. Matching peripheral-trap exact formulas were not located in the actual published-finding and literature searches. Priority risk: a broader implicit derivation or unlocated work may exist.
residual_risks: General graph-resolvent methods can implicitly yield the rational identity, and unlocated earlier exact specializations remain possible.
No exhaustive search of every physics journal or unpublished thesis; originality remains a best-knowledge assessment, not a proof of priority.

value.rationale: The peripheral-trapped star has a dark network sector whose capture requires dephasing. The exact rational mean, a globally unique bath–trap control pair for every size, and distinct sharp N^{1/2} optimal-rate constants with an N^{3/2} mean-time law are natural quantities for network-assisted transport, not a parameter renaming or isolated table entry.
